file_assets_dimensions_valid.name: file_assets_dimensions_valid
file_assets_dimensions_valid.value: ("file_assets"."width" is null) = ("file_assets"."height" is null) and ("file_assets"."width" is null or ("file_assets"."width" > 0 and "file_assets"."height" > 0 and "file_assets"."kind" = 'IMAGE'))

conversations_direct_pair_shape.name: conversations_direct_pair_shape
conversations_direct_pair_shape.value: ("conversations"."direct_user_low" is null) = ("conversations"."direct_user_high" is null) and ("conversations"."type" = 'DIRECT') = ("conversations"."direct_user_low" is not null) and ("conversations"."direct_user_low" is null or "conversations"."direct_user_low" < "conversations"."direct_user_high")

conversations_title_shape.name: conversations_title_shape
conversations_title_shape.value: ("conversations"."type" = 'DIRECT') = ("conversations"."title" is null) and ("conversations"."title" is null or char_length("conversations"."title") between 1 and 100)

messages_body_length.name: messages_body_length
messages_body_length.value: "messages"."body" is null or char_length("messages"."body") between 1 and 4000

messages_text_has_body.name: messages_text_has_body
messages_text_has_body.value: "messages"."type" <> 'TEXT' or "messages"."body" is not null or "messages"."deleted_at" is not null

messages_lifecycle_after_creation.name: messages_lifecycle_after_creation
messages_lifecycle_after_creation.value: ("messages"."edited_at" is null or "messages"."edited_at" >= "messages"."created_at") and ("messages"."deleted_at" is null or "messages"."deleted_at" >= "messages"."created_at")
